info.description: A label, a destination and how it should look.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Label
edit.description: The words the visitor reads. Leave this empty where the link wraps an image.

edit.label: URL
edit.description: Where the link goes. A path such as /about for this site, or a full address for another.

edit.label: Style
edit.description: Whether the link reads as text in a sentence or stands on its own as a button.
